blurb: Guests cruise the Oceanside waters of the Salish Sea from Qualicum Beach to Nanoose Bay and may venture to nearby islands. Tours include viewing marine wildlife such as seals, sea lions, hawks, eagles, and occasionally orcas and humpback whales. The boat is a 26-foot Transport Canada registered Striper, captained by Tony Pisto, a Transport Canada Certified Small Vessel Captain with over 50 years of boating experience.
